normalization: member NPZ mean/std over raw112 + causal event99
feature_path: wnn.features.event_features_torch; row zero resets event state per sequence
model_path: wnn.nn.RNNModel with archived linear-head width; strict FP32 state load
precision: FP32 CUDA; TF32 disabled; no autocast; stateful recurrent chunks; causal event features computed on each complete sequence
recurrent_chunking_note: GRU hidden state is carried across adjacent chunks; CUDA kernels may still produce small FP32 rounding differences from one unchunked full-sequence forward.
native_difference: Per-member unweighted PyTorch FP32 output; original callback uses precision=q8vnni (8-bit Q8VNNI), fast_activations=True with fixed ensemble coefficients. FP32 weights/activations, the omitted ensemble weighting, and GPU PyTorch GRU/GELU arithmetic mean outputs are not expected to be numerically identical to the quantized native callback. No FP32-versus-native numerical delta is measured by this exporter; this is a diagnostic endpoint, not native callback parity.
scope: diagnostic FP32 member predictions on supplied validation; no grade or selection claim
